[Original Webtoon](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=6616682)

**Official Translations:**  
[French](https://www.ono.live/webtoon/telle-une-oasis-dans-le-desert)

"I'm a merchant. I'm going to see a wider world, buy more. Yeah, including you."

Yoo's top group, which buys and sells goods around the world,  
Yu Seong-an, the only daughter of Yoo's upper end, is born in the desert and grows through a long journey from the Korean Peninsula to Europe.

And in the process, regardless of nationality, I get involved with countless men...


"Gilsang, you're my first friend. ... I hope we can continue to be with you in the future."

"Sarbar, we..."

"I can't be with you even if I die and wake up, Samabu."


In the 8th century, romance set around the world unfolds in a turbulent era.
